title: IDS 2027
body_markdown:
**Discover the Future of Digital Dentistry with 3D Systems and NextDent at IDS 2027**


Join us at IDS 2027, the world’s leading trade show for the dental industry, and discover 3D Systems full range of end-to-end dental solutions, including our newest innovation multi-material, monolithic Jetted Dentures.


**Meet us in Hall 03.1, Booth K-010 – L-011** March 16-20 and see how 3D Systems and NextDent are revolutionizing dental manufacturing. Schedule a meeting with one of our dental application experts to discuss your current workflow challenges and how our digital dentistry solutions can help you increase productivity and reduce labor costs.
